name: Astor
description: A Keldon runner undergoing a trial to become a warlord.

description_citations.text: "The Myths of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor learns the foundation myths of Keld during his trial to become a warlord.
timeline.quote: as the Keldon runner Astor undergoes a trial to become a warlord

citation.text: "The Myths of Magic", section "Keldon Fire , by Scott McGough". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri makes peace with Warlord Astor as Skyshroud overlays Keld.
timeline.quote: Skyshroud forest overlayed in Keld and Eladamri the Elflord made peace with Warlord Astor of Keld.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri and Astor's armies make a stand against the Phyrexians at the Keldon Necropolis.
timeline.quote: Together, their armies of elves and Keldons made a desperate stand against the advancing Phyrexian forces

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy arrives and rescues survivors.
timeline.quote: The ship’s crew pulled many survivors

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Keld fallen Keldon heroes return fighting for Phyrexia; Tajamin melts the glacier, drowning Phyrexians, and the Golden Argosy saves most Keldons and elves and carries them to Urborg.
timeline.quote: Doyenne Tajamin uses her holy cudgel to melt the entire glacier on which the battle is being fought.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha claims her Keldon heritage on the Mountain, retrieves Astor's daggers and leads the new nation of Keld; her planeswalker spark is permanently extinguished.
timeline.quote: thus she will never be able to ascend.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor burns out Skouras's brain with the Lethans' fury and is hailed as the new doyen of Keld.
timeline.quote: burning the dragon's brain out

citation.text: "The Dragons of Magic", section "Keldon Staredown , by Scott McGough". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a boy Astor serves as a camp runner for Commander Treulk, the best messenger he had.
timeline.quote: Astor spent much of his early life as a camp runner for Commander Treulk

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olvresk takes Astor from Treulk and sends him to train under Tajamin.
timeline.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Disagreeing with Tajamin's methods, Olvresk storms her compound and his Fists slaughter many of her people; Tajamin saves herself and Astor by invoking the Tinder Spell.
timeline.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor learns the Tinder Spell in two days without food, and Tajamin teaches him of Jezal's Covenant.
timeline.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Beginnings". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the Mountain Astor slays a Colos for food and fights off the wolves it attracts.
timeline.quote: Astor had found food by slaying a Colos

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the peak Astor sees a vision of Kradak, who warns of the coming Keldon Twilight, and Astor becomes a warlord.
timeline.quote: Astor stood tall at the highest peak of Keld as a warlord

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At nineteen Astor is granted the far northern lands by Olvresk and sets out to confront a dragon that seems to have broken her oath.
timeline.quote: Astor had been granted the lands of the far north

citation.text: "Astor", section "Keldon Staredown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor finds that Skouras killed the resident dragon; Skouras tears through his troops, but Astor hurls the dead dragon's egg into Skouras's hoard as a bomb.
timeline.quote: Astor used the captured egg of the dead dragon as a bomb and hurled it into Skouras's horde

citation.text: "Astor", section "Keldon Staredown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor retreats to Letha, blows up the village to ground Skouras, and kills him by channeling the power of Keld into the dragon's mind.
timeline.quote: This had the rather spectacular effect of exploding the dragon's head.

citation.text: "Astor", section "Keldon Staredown". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the Rathi Overlay begins, Freyalise plants the Skyshroud Forest in Keld; Astor meets Eladamri and takes him in, uniting Keldons and Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: Astor accepted the elf and began to teach him the ways of Keld

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the battle for the Keldon Necropolis the Keldon Twilight occurs, and the fallen chieftains side with the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Unfortunately, they instead sided with their undead kin, the Phyrexians.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor and Eladamri arrive in Urborg to join the metathran army under Grizzlegom.
timeline.quote: Astor arrived alongside Eladamri in the swamps to unite with the metathran army.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri allies with the stone dwarves, and the combined force attacks from behind, destroys the Portcullis and raids the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: defeated the outflanked Phyrexians and destroyed the gate before raiding the Stronghold

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth begins emerging through the portal in the Stronghold; the allies flee on the Weatherlight and Gerrard plugs the volcano with a plague ship.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth began emerging through the planar portal in Stronghold's throne room.

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Battle of Urborg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion Astor has a child with a Skyshroud elf, whom he supports from afar.
timeline.quote: Astor became involved with a female Skyshroud elf

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha searches for Astor's tomb in the Necropolis and finds only his twin kukris.
timeline.quote: she found no corpse in his tomb, only his twin kukris

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During Sheoldred's invasion the Golden Argosy returns carrying Astor, restored to his senses after centuries, and he fights his old foes again.
timeline.quote: the Golden Argosy returned, carrying Astor aboard

citation.text: "Astor", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olvresk takes Astor from Treulk and sends him to train under Tajamin.
timeline.quote: Olvresk took him from Treulk and sent Astor to train under Doyenne Tajamin

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olvresk stormed Tajamin's compound with his Fists and slaughtered many; Tajamin saves herself and Astor by proposing Olvresk teach the Tinder Spell.
timeline.quote: He stormed Tajamin's compound and used his Fists, his elite soldiers, to slaughter many of Tajamin's people.

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor learns the spell in two days without food; Tajamin tells him of Jezal's Covenant.
timeline.quote: Two days later, Astor knew the spell

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Astor slays a Colos on the Mountain and fights off wolves.
timeline.quote: Astor fought them off before continuing further up the mountain.

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "The Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the peak Astor sees a vision of Kradak, who warns of the Keldon Twilight, and becomes a warlord.
timeline.quote: Kradak warned Astor of the coming of the Keldon Twilight in Astor's lifetime.

citation.text: "Olvresk", section "The Mountain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Keldon Twilight", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Astor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
